facts_found: The personal Platinum Rewards Card earns 10.0% cash back on all eligible purchases. [doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_002]

Platinum Rewards Card rewards can be redeemed once the available rewards balance reaches at least $15. [doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_002]
The personal Diamond Elite Card earns 5.0% cash back on all eligible purchases. [doc_credit_cards_diamond_elite_card_003]
The Diamond Elite Card standard annual fee is $495.00. [doc_credit_cards_diamond_elite_card_006]

Diamond Elite Card rewards can be redeemed once the available rewards balance meets at least 5. [doc_credit_cards_diamond_elite_card_003]
The personal Gold Rewards Card earns 2.5% cash back on all purchases. [doc_credit_cards_gold_rewards_card_001]
The Gold Rewards Card annual fee is $0.00. [doc_credit_cards_gold_rewards_card_001]
The Gold Rewards Card requires an active Rho-Bank+ premium subscription. [doc_credit_cards_gold_rewards_card_001]
The Gold Rewards Card minimum credit score required is 720. [doc_credit_cards_gold_rewards_card_001]
Gold Rewards Card has a $15 minimum rewards redemption threshold, 0% foreign transaction fee, and $32.50 late payment fee. [doc_credit_cards_gold_rewards_card_001]
The personal Silver Rewards Card has a $0.00 annual fee and a minimum credit score requirement of 680. [doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_001]

Silver Rewards Card foreign transaction fee is 2.75% without a premium subscription and 0% with a premium subscription. [doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_001]
The personal Bronze Rewards Card earns 1.0% cash back on eligible purchases and has no annual fee. [doc_credit_cards_bronze_rewards_card_002]

Bronze Rewards Card typically does not earn rewards on fees, interest charges, and cash-like transactions; returns or refunds reverse rewards, and disputed transactions do not earn rewards until resolved and posted. [doc_credit_cards_bronze_rewards_card_002]
The personal EcoCard earns sustainability points, with 5 points per dollar on green purchases and 1 point per dollar on other purchases. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_006]
EcoCard has a $50.00 annual fee and minimum credit score requirement of 0, indicating no credit score requirement. [doc_credit_cards_ecocard_001]
EcoCard sustainability points redeem at $0.01 per point when redeemed as a statement credit or checking account credit. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_006]
Crypto-Cash Back card minimum credit score is 660 and a late payment fee of $32.50 may apply. [doc_credit_cards_crypto-cash_back_009]

Rho-Bank cash back cards include Bronze Rewards Card, Silver Rewards Card, Gold Rewards Card, Platinum Rewards Card, Diamond Elite Card, and Crypto-Cash Back; EcoCard is the only true points-based card. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_006]
